observations: Historical personality keeps thirteen private continuous signed scores, clamps ordinary set and deed mutation, and projects visible traits while preserving demographics. Missing scores or projections have neutral fallbacks; the development replay comparator checks character, axis, delta, deed and virtue but not the recorded minute. All mutation sources, fallback semantics, stored row admissions and replay identity remain open.

Historical relationship chronology distinguishes personal and global present, partitions NPC intervals around lifecycle boundaries and represents birth coordinates, commitments, pregnancies and unique participant records separately. Schema state parsers exist but native writes, cache consistency and each producer require connected review.

The historical global lifecycle queue sorts wedding and birth events, filters processability and applies its limit before dispatch. Birth preflight quarantines invalid pregnancies, while wedding dispatch catches a settlement error and records a cancellation; the complete wedding write and error path must be traced before assessing transaction effects.

Historical newborn residence attachment intentionally ignores a housing failure after birth and retains household membership. Household and kinship records, relationship state, personal frontier, scheduler and downstream projections need independent assessment for aggregate guarantees and authority.
